correctness.rationale: For finite two-agent frame with named reflexive row and column relations and one Ferrers-valued atom, modal t-types are exactly the current truth signature and the SETS of predecessor t−1 types in its row and column. Twin rows/columns may be collapsed because counts do not enter. Every Ferrers profile reduces to one of four strict staircase incidence matrices (both boundaries absent/present or exactly one), where balanced (r=c) block peeling yields (t+1)²+1 modal types before capping r², while unbalanced |r−c|=1 alternating peel yields (t+1)²+1_even before cap rc. Cases including constant labels and r/c=1 are covered. This gives log2|D_t| exactly and the stated stabilization depths. An independent set-signature enumerator for every 912 Ferrers shapes with m,n≤5 passed 6,976 depth comparisons including all-zero/full/duplicated rows. The general induction, not finite enumeration, establishes arbitrary m,n.

Bezhanishvili–Meadors 2023/24 gives broad MS4 algebraic local-finiteness setting, not this chain-graph parity law. Groote et al and Kiefer–McKay study general bisimulation refinement or multiset color refinement, not the set-signature Ferrers class. Earlier balanced staircase special result is strictly subsumed, but the boundary parity and all profiles are new against inspected literature.
